 SECTIONS November 2026 Festival List: From Dhanteras and Diwali to Chhath Puja, Dev Diwali and Guru Nanak Jayanti, check complete calendar of festivals and important dates By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 02, 2026, 11:48:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis November 2026 Festival Calendar: November 2026 marks an important time for religious observances and celebrations across India. Significant festivals include Dhanteras, Diwali, Govardhan Puja, and Bhai Dooj, among others. Devotees will partake in various traditional rituals during these festive occasions. Important celebrations such as Chhath Puja, Tulsi Vivah, and Guru Nanak Jayanti will also take place in this month. The article provides an overview of dates and significance for each festival.

 November brings several major festivals and religious celebrations across India, making it an important month for devotees and families. From Dhanteras, Diwali and Govardhan Puja to Bhai Dooj, Chhath Puja, Dev Diwali and Guru Nanak Jayanti, the month is filled with festive occasions, traditional rituals and auspicious observances. Here is the complete list of festivals and important dates in November 2026.

 Important festivals in November 2026
 1. Dhanteras - November 6 
 Dhanteras marks the beginning of Diwali festivities. People worship Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Dhanvantari and traditionally purchase gold, silver and utensils.
 2. Diwali - November 8 
The festival of lights will be celebrated with Lakshmi Puja, diyas, rangoli, sweets and decorations.
 3. Govardhan Pooja - November 10 
 Live Events
 The festival commemorates Lord Krishna lifting Govardhan Hill to protect the people of Vrindavan from heavy rainfall.
 4. Bhai Dooj - November 11 
 Bhai Dooj celebrates the bond between brothers and sisters, with sisters applying tilak and praying for their brothers' well-being.
 5. Chhath Puja - November 13 
Devotees worship the Sun God and Chhathi Maiya and offer prayers to the setting sun. The four-day observance begins on November 13.
 6. Tulsi Vivah- November 21 
Tulsi Vivah marks the ceremonial marriage of Goddess Tulsi with Lord Vishnu or his form, Shaligram.
 7. Dev Diwali - November 24 
Celebrated on Kartik Purnima, Dev Diwali is marked by lighting lamps, especially along the ghats of Varanasi.
 8. Guru Nanak Jayanti - November 24 
The birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the founder of Sikhism, is observed with prayers, kirtans, processions and langars.
 FAQS
 1. Which are the major festivals celebrated in November 2026? 
Some of the major festivals in November 2026 include Dhanteras, Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Chhath Puja, Tulsi Vivah, Dev Diwali and Guru Nanak Jayanti.
 2. When is Diwali celebrated in 2026? 
Diwali will be celebrated on November 8, 2026, which falls on a Sunday. The festival will be observed with Lakshmi Puja, lighting diyas and decorating homes.
 3. When is Dhanteras in November 2026? 
Dhanteras will be observed on November 6, 2026. It marks the beginning of the five-day Diwali festivities.
 4. When is Chhath Puja in 2026? 
Chhath Puja will be observed from November 13 to November 16, 2026. Devotees worship the Sun God and Chhathi Maiya during the four-day festival.
 5. When is Bhai Dooj celebrated in 2026? 
Bhai Dooj will be celebrated on November 11, 2026. The festival celebrates the special bond between brothers and sisters.
 6. When is Guru Nanak Jayanti in 2026? 
Guru Nanak Jayanti will be celebrated on November 24, 2026, marking the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji.
